entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-06
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Error writing to XML documentation file: Object reference not set to an instance of an object. #81090
  • Ability to revert the rename refactoring UI back to its more sensible previous behavior seems to be missing. #81089

  • C\# Formatter incorrectly indents braces of collection initializers on a clean installation. #81083
